title: Microsoft Fabric Failures by Workspace
dataSources: Fabric capacity metrics (`fabric:capacity:metrics`) and admin API.
app: Microsoft Fabric Capacity Metrics app exports and the Fabric Admin API via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=fabric:capacity:metrics status="Failure"
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by workspace_name
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts Microsoft Fabric failures grouped by workspace so operators immediately see which specific workspaces are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'Microsoft Fabric is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest Microsoft Fabric failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical workspaces.
visualization: Table of workspace by failure count and last failure time.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of Microsoft Fabric are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
